objects.name: Analytic 1891
objects.description: Real-time monitoring identifies a Linux process with both a listening socket on an Industrial Control System (ICS) protocol port and an outbound connection to a non-ICS destination, or iptables DNAT/REDIRECT rules added on ICS protocol ports. OT operational-fidelity gate: Alert only when the asset's documented role does not permit the connection and the destination/proxy/service is outside the approved communications profile, with process/service identity used as corroboration where available. Suppress approved vendor support, update repositories, remote operations, failover paths, and documented temporary connectivity.
